sources.snippet: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct is a member of the latest Qwen3 series from Alibaba's Qwen team. It is a Mixture of Experts (MoE) model with 30 billion total parameters and 3 billion active parameters, which effectively reduces inference costs while maintaining powerful performance.
